song.name: The Curse
song.plot: Acheron reflects on the permanence of the Thirst. He realizes that by attempting to transcend his Aurorian exile, he permanently cursed his lineage to be eternal parasites.
song.analysis: User-approved minimal-modification approach (~120 BGD): Verse 1, all Choruses, and Verse 3 kept 100% verbatim (hook remains "Curse of the Oath"); Verse 2 altered on line 2 only ("A curse takes hold, the darkness mesh" -> "The Thirst takes hold, the darkness' mesh" — names the curse as the Thirst and fixes the broken grammar); Bridge reworked to anchor the lore: the lost Aurorian Spark, the fall, severed forever from divine light, bound to the Thirst. All sections preserve the original per-line syllable counts (V1 9-8-10-8, Chorus 8-9-10-8, V2 8-8-10-8, Bridge 9-8-10-10, V3 11-9-10-8). Song fades out on a truncated chorus, mirroring the truncated original ending. Suggested song direction: tragic, introspective, poetic — sparse piano or strings, intimate vocal delivery, building resignation.
